observations.note: Procedure step 8 says to write all completed marks in one edit of the plan, but the session made three separate plan edits, one per row.

conformance.item: Procedure 1: read plan rows and triage note first
Procedure 3: write tests first and see them fail for the right reason
Procedure 4: smallest code change in the named files
Procedure 6: run only the test files the rows name, as plain commands
Procedure 7: check specs the change touches that the plan does not name
Procedure 8: completed marks in one plan edit
Limits: no git commit, push or gh
